item.title: SYW323 - My Way with Nelya Lutsyuk
item.description: In this episode I'm interviewing Nelya Lutsyuk for the My Way series. My Way is all about celebrating the unique ways memory keepers get things done. We’re excited to have Nelya as the January featured artist at Simple Scrapper.

item.title: SYW324 - How to Start Scrapbooking Again with Laura O'Donnell
item.description: In this episode Laura O'Donnell talks about her seven-year break from scrapbooking and how a gratitude practice brought her back to the hobby. Her story offers a reminder that it’s never too late to return to something that brings you joy.

item.title: SYW325 - Simplifying Annual Scrapbook Projects
item.description: In this episode I’m chatting with Megan Dosch about how she manages multiple scrapbook projects throughout the year. She shares her process for completing digital and physical projects by working in small pockets of time and embracing "good enough" to keep documenting without burning out.

item.title: Interview: My Way with Valerie Bisson
item.description: In this blog post I’m interviewing Valerie Bisson for the My Way series. My Way is all about celebrating the unique ways memory keepers get things done.

item.title: SYW326 - Balancing Multiple Scrapbook Projects with Sarah Jürs
item.description: In this episode I’m chatting with Sarah Jürs about how she balances multiple memory keeping projects while working full-time and raising her son in Germany. Our conversation includes her approach to documenting different projects and how daily journaling keeps her grounded.

item.title: SYW327 - Interactive Scrapbooking with Brie Beaupre
item.description: In this episode I'm chatting with Brie Beaupre about her innovative approach to getting tons of photos on her pages. Our conversation focuses on the benefits and strategies of Brie’s signature interactive scrapbooking process.

item.title: SYW328 - My Way with Cassie Wiscarson
item.description: In this episode I'm interviewing Cassie Wiscarson for the My Way series. My Way is all about celebrating the unique ways memory keepers get things done. We're excited to have Cassie as the March featured artist at Simple Scrapper.

item.title: SYW329 - Use What You Have with Alissa Williams
item.description: In this episode I’m chatting with Alissa Williams about stash management. We explore how she acquires, organizes, and uses her supplies, and what intentional scrapbooking looks like when you’ve decided to stop buying and start creating.

item.title: SYW330 - Use Your Stash in Creative Ways with Anna Komenda
item.description: In this episode I’m chatting with Anna Komenda, a Polish scrapbooker known for her colorful, layered style, about how she creates and the techniques that keep her pages fresh and original.
